auth object with empty username in basic auth is rejected

```typescript title="WebAssembly"
import { WasmAuthConfig, WasmCrawlConfig, createEngine, scrape } from "@xberg-io/crawlberg-wasm";
async function main() {
  const engineConfig = WasmCrawlConfig.default();
  engineConfig.auth = { password: "secret", type: "basic", username: "" } as WasmAuthConfig;
  engineConfig.ssrf.denyPrivate = false;
  const engine = createEngine(engineConfig);
  const url = "https://example.com";
  try {
    await scrape(engine, url);
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(String(error));
  }
}

void main();
```
